selection.rule: Every project of construction-progress.json (a plot-level pin in our records, at least 3 decimals, not shared, not an area centre; Sumba excluded).

panoramax.name: Panoramax
panoramax.licence: per photo: CC BY-SA 4.0 or Licence Ouverte 2.0 (etalab-2.0)
panoramax.note: Federated open street-level imagery; faces and number plates are blurred by the hosting instance.

kartaview.name: KartaView
kartaview.note: Open street-level imagery; faces and number plates are blurred by KartaView.

commons.name: Wikimedia Commons
commons.licence: only files under CC0, public domain, CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-SA 4.0
commons.note: Only street-level files imported from Mapillary (title starting "Mapillary"); the author and full licence are on each file page.

not_used.Google Street View: needs an API key and its terms do not allow storing results

method: For each pin, every photo the three sources return within 200 m, newest capture first, at most one photo per sequence (a drive or walk of many frames counts once), at most 4 per project. d: metres from the pin; az: the direction the camera faced, degrees from north, where recorded; to: the direction from the photo to the pin. Credit and licence: through the link to each photo's own page, which names the author. The thumbnail is the source's own, unchanged. We keep no EXIF and no names.
